messages:
Jordan: Morning all  first week Q: where's the best place to post these 3 things so they don't get lost: (1) laptop order, (2) API key request, (3) weird local test that fails only on my machine?
onboarding-bot: Welcome Jordan! :tada: Short map: laptop -> #people-ops (use /claim-laptop), API keys -> #support for product keys or #eng for infra keys (use /request-api-key), flaky local tests -> start in #eng with branch + failing CI link; only escalate to #eng-oncall if it blocks prod.

Tess: For the flaky test, paste the failing test output and the exact command you ran. Start a thread per issue so each ticket stays focused. Prefix messages like `[laptop]` `[keys]` `[build]` so search picks them up.

Jordan: Should I DM someone (like an approver) or always post in channel?

HR: DM approvers only for paygrade or PII. For access, post in #help and @mention the approver if it's urgent. We monitor tags `urgent` and `onboard` during business hours.

Jordan: Any recommended bot commands to kick off flows?

onboarding-bot: Handy commands:
```
/setup-checklist   -> DM with step-by-step onboarding tasks
/claim-laptop      -> starts procurement form in #people-ops
/request-api-key   -> files ticket in #support and notifies owners
/intro             -> posts a 1-line intro template to #new-hires
```

Tess: Pro tip: run `/setup-checklist` first, complete the "service account" step before requesting keys. If you need a quick review, paste the ACL error like `403: missing permission` in the thread.

infra-bot: Reminder: to trigger infra watchers add `INC:` at the start of a message in #eng-oncall for paging; normal help threads should not use that.

Jordan: How do we mark things resolved?

Tess: Add a :white_check_mark: or say "resolved" in-thread and close the ticket if one was created. If an issue becomes a new engineering task, open a repo issue and link it.

Jordan: Where should I post social/intro stuff?

HR: Use #new-hires for formal intros (include timezone), #random for casual chat, #lunch-plans for meetup invites. Welcome aboard! :wave:

Jordan: Thanks everyone  I'll run the checklist and open separate threads for each item. Appreciate the quick answers!
